learning_outcomes.details: Nắm vững những nội dung về sự ra đời, các giai đoạn phát triển, đối tượng, phương pháp và ý nghĩa của việc nghiên cứu chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học. Nắm vững được những tri thức cơ bản, cốt lõi nhất của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, một trong ba bộ phận cấu thành chủ nghĩa Mác - Lenin To master the contents regarding the emergence, stages of development, subject, methodology, and significance of studying Scientific Socialism. To firmly grasp the fundamental and core knowledge of Scientific Socialism, one of the three integral components of Marxism–Leninism.

Xây dựng kỹ năng lập luận, soạn thảo bài viết, thuyết trình, tư duy phản biện, xử lý các quan hệ xã hội và hoạt động nhóm. Xây dựng kỹ năng thích ứng, tự học, sử dụng AI có trách nhiệm, đạo đức phù hợp với quan điểm triết học, văn hóa - xã hội, lịch sử Việt Nam Develop skills of argument, writing, presentations, critical thinking, handling social relations and group activities. To build adaptability and self-learning skills, and to use AI responsibly and ethically in alignment with philosophical perspectives as well as Vietnam’s cultural, social, and historical context.
Nắm vững những nội dung của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về sứ mệnh lịch sử của giai cấp công nhân Master Marxism-Leninism theory on the historical mission of the working class

Nắm vững những quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về chủ nghĩa xã hội, thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội bỏ qua chế độ tư bản chủ nghĩa ở Việt Nam và sự vận dụng sáng tạo của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam vào điều kiện cụ thể Việt Nam Master the Marxist-Leninist views on socialism, the transitional period towards socialism while ignoring the capitalist regime in Vietnam and the Communist Party of Vietnam's creative application to Vietnamese practices

Nắm vững những quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về nền dân chủ xã hội chủ nghĩa và nhà nước xã hội chủ nghĩa, quan điểm của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam về việc xây dựng và hoàn thiện nền dân chủ và nhà nước xã hội chủ nghĩa ở Việt Nam hiện nay Master the Marxist-Leninist views on socialist democracy and the socialist state, the Communist Party of Vietnam's view on building and perfecting socialist democracy and state in Vietnam today

Nắm vững cơ cấu xã hội - giai cấp và liên minh giai cấp, tầng lớp trong thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội Master social-class structure and alliances of class in the transitional period to socialism.

Nắm vững những quan điểm cơ bản của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin, đường lối, chính sách của Đảng và nhà nước Việt Nam về vấn đề dân tộc và tôn giáo Master fundamental viewpoints of Marxism-Leninism and the Vietnamese Party and State's lines and policies on ethnicity, religion issues

Nắm vững những quan điểm cơ bản của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về vấn đề gia đình trong thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội Master fundamental viewpoints of Marxism-Leninism on family problems in the transitional period to socialism

Nâng cao năng lực hiểu biết thực tiễn và khả năng vận dụng các tri thức Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học vào việc xem xét, đánh giá các vấn đề chính trị xã hội liên quan đến con đường đi lên chủ nghĩa xã hội của đất nước. Có thái độ chính trị đúng đắn về môn học nói riêng và nền tảng tư tưởng của Đảng nói chung. To enhance practical understanding and the ability to apply the knowledge of Scientific Socialism in examining and evaluating socio-political issues related to the country’s path toward socialism. To develop a proper political attitude toward the subject in particular and toward the ideological foundation of the Party in general.

Hình thành năng lực lý luận và ứng dụng thực tiễn, nhấn mạnh vai trò công dân và tinh thần trách nhiệm xã hội. Hình thành thế giới quan, phương pháp luận thích ứng trước sự biến đổi nhanh chóng của thời đại, khoa học công nghệ. Hiểu được tầm quan trọng của giá trị nhân văn, xã hội trong tiến trình phát triển của nhân loại. To develop reasoning competence and practical application skills, with an emphasis on civic roles and social responsibility. To foster a worldview and methodology capable of adapting to the rapid transformations of the era and advances in science and technology. To understand the significance of humanistic and social values in the development of humankind.

metadata.title: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.english_title: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là một chuyên ngành, một bộ phận của khoa học lịch sử. Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh đã khẳng định Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là cả một pho lịch sử bằng vàng. Đó chính là tính khoa học, cách mạng, giá trị thực tiễn sâu sắc trong Cương lĩnh, đường lối của Đảng; là sự lãnh đạo đúng đắn, đáp ứng kịp thời những yêu cầu, nhiệm vụ do lịch sử đặt ra; những kinh nghiệm, bài học có tính quy luật, lý luận của cách mạng Việt Nam và những truyền thống vẻ vang của Đảng.
Nghiên cứu, học tập lịch sử Đảng không chỉ nắm vững những sự kiện, cột mốc lịch sử mà cần thấu hiểu những vấn đề phong phú đó trong quá trình lãnh đạo và đấu tranh, để vận dụng, phát triển trong thời kỳ đổi mới toàn diện, đẩy mạnh công nghiệp hóa, hiện đại hóa đất nước và hội nhập quốc tế hiện nay.
Course introduction: History of CPV is a major and a division of historical science. President Ho Chi Minh affirmed that the history of the Communist Party of Vietnam is golden pages. That is scientific, revolutionary and profound practical value in the Party's platforms and guidelines, is proper leadership and timely response to requirements and missions set by the history; is the normative and theoretical experiences and lessons of Vietnamese revolution and the glorious traditions of the Party.
Researching and studying history of CPV not only requires mastering historical events and milestones but also understanding those issues in the process of leading and struggling; thereby applying and developing in the current period of comprehensive renovation and accelerating industrialization and modernization and international integration.

Mục tiêu môn học:
- Về nội dung: Cung cấp những tri thức có tính hệ thống, cơ bản về sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920- 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930- 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945- 1975), trong sự nghiệp xây dựng, bảo vệ Tổ quốc thời kỳ cả nước quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975- 2018).
- Về tư tưởng: Thông qua các sự kiện lịch sử và các kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo của Đảng để xây dựng ý thức tôn trọng sự thật khách quan, nâng cao lòng tự hào, niềm tin của sinh viên vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng trong quá khứ và hiện tại.
- Về kỹ năng: Trang bị phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử, kỹ năng lựa chọn tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập môn học và khả năng vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử vào công tác thực tiễn, phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng.

Course Objectives:
- Knowledge: Students will understand basic and systematic knowledge of the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920–1930); the Party’s leadership in the struggle for power (1930–1945); the Party’s leadership in the two wars against French colonialism and U.S. imperialism (1945–1975); and the Party’s leadership in the national transition to socialism and the Doi Moi reforms (1975–2018).
- Attitudes: Through historical events and experiences of the Party’s leadership, students will develop respect for objective truth, and deepen pride and confidence in the Party’s leadership in the past and present.
- Skills: Students will develop scientific thinking about history, skills in selecting research and study materials, and the ability to apply historical knowledge in practice, critically evaluate misconceptions about the Party’s history.

Nội dung môn học:
Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên những hiểu biết cơ bản về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam; những kiến thức cơ bản, cốt lõi, có hệ thống về sự ra đời của Đảng (1920 - 1930), về quá trình Đảng lãnh đạo cách mạng Việt Nam từ năm 1930 cho đến nay, từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng.
Ngoài Chương nhập môn, nội dung môn học được bố cục gồm 3 chương:
- Chương 1: Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam ra đời và lãnh đạo đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945);
- Chương II: Đảng lãnh đạo hai cuộc kháng chiến, hoàn thành giải phóng dân tộc, thống nhất đất nước (1945 - 1975);
- Chương III: Đảng lãnh đạo cả nước quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội và tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975 - 2018).
Qua đó khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo cách mạng của Đảng để giúp người học nâng cao nhận thức, niềm tin đổi với Đảng và khả năng vận dụng kiến thức đã học vào thực tiễn công tác, góp phần xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc Việt Nam xã hội chủ nghĩa.

This course provides students with basic knowledge of objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV; the basic, core, systematic knowledge of the Party establishment (1920 - 1930), the process of the Party's leading the Vietnamese revolution from 1930 to the present, thereby, by affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experience of the Party’s leadership in revolutionary practices.
In addition to the introductory chapter, the course content includes three chapters:
- Chapter 1: The Communist Party of Vietnam was founded and led the rise to power (1930-1945);
- Chapter II: The Party led two resistance wars, completing national liberation and reunion (1945 - 1975);
- Chapter III: The Party led the national transition to socialism and carrying out the Doi moi (1975-2018).
Through this, students will recognize the achievements and identify the limitations of the Party’s revolutionary leadership, summarize the experiences gained, enhance their awareness and confidence in the Party, and develop the ability to apply the knowledge learned to practical work, contributing to the construction and defense of a socialist Vietnam.

Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng. Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm, thuyết trình và thực hiện sản phẩm sáng tạo (tham khảo và ứng dụng phần mềm AI một cách có trách nhiệm).
Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning groupwork assignments. Organizing and guiding students in group discussions, presentations, and the development of creative products (with the responsible and ethical use of AI tools)

learning_outcomes.details: Hiểu được về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam Understand the objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV

Phân tích sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920 - 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945 - 1975) Analyze the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920 - 1930), the Party's leadership over the period of Rise to power (1930 - 1945) and two resistance wars against French colonialist and American imperialist invasions (1945 - 1975)

Nắm được quá trình xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc, quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới toàn diện đất nước (1975 - 2018) của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam. Từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng Understand the national construction and defense, the transition to socialism, the implementation of the comprehensive renovation of the country (1975 - 2018) of the Communist Party of Vietnam. Thereby, affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experiences on leadership in revolutionary practices.

Củng cố và nâng cao niềm tin, niềm tự hào vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng, định hướng phấn đấu theo mục tiêu, lý tưởng của Đảng Strengthen and enhance trust and pride in the Party’s leadership, and orient students to strive toward the Party’s goals and ideals.

Củng cố, nâng cao ý thức tự rèn luyện và tu dưỡng đạo đức cách mạng; thể hiện nhận thức chính trị, tư tưởng đúng đắn trong học tập và hoạt động thực tiễn Consolidate and strengthen students’ awareness of self-discipline and the cultivation of revolutionary ethics; and demonstrate sound political and ideological awareness in academic work and practical activities.
Nâng cao ý thức rõ hơn về trách nhiệm công dân trước những nhiệm vụ trọng đại của đất nước Raise higher sense of civic responsibility over important duties of the country

Xây dựng phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử; kỹ năng lựa chọn và tổng hợp tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập; phát triển kỹ năng làm việc cá nhân và nhóm; ứng dụng công nghệ, đặc biệt là AI một cách có đạo đức và trách nhiệm để hỗ trợ nghiên cứu và học tập; đồng thời nâng cao kỹ năng thuyết trình và trình bày sản phẩm, kết quả nghiên cứu gắn với chủ trương của Đảng Develop scientific thinking methods in history; acquire skills in selecting and synthesizing research and learning materials; strengthen individual and group work skills; apply technology, especially AI, in an ethical and responsible manner to support research and learning; and enhance presentation skills in delivering research products and outcomes in line with the Party’s guidelines.

Vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử và thực tiễn để nhận diện, phân tích và chủ động phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng Apply historical and practical knowledge to identify, analyze, and proactively criticize false perceptions of the Party’s history.

Vận dụng quan điểm của Đảng vào cuộc sống và công tác, biết kết hợp với những kiến thức chuyên ngành để chủ động, tích cực giải quyết những thực tiễn đặt ra theo đường lối, chính sách, pháp luật của Đảng và Nhà nước Apply the Party's viewpoints to life and work, combine it with specialized knowledge to proactively solve problems in reality in accordance with the guidelines, policies and laws of the Party and State

metadata.title: Front Office Management_Quản lý tiền sảnh, lễ tân
metadata.description:
This course consists of the study of hotel front office procedures, with the primary focus is the front office, housekeeping, reservations, and night audit departments. Other departments are discussed to provide and understanding of how these departments relate to the front office and how they operate to enhance the guest experience. The course gives students a real world understanding of the hotel industry balancing its past, present and future. It reveals the inner workings of a hotel in a way that both promotes learning and interest for the students, preparing them for what to expect in the current and future hotel market.
-Description:The course focuses on the front office, housekeeping, F&B and how they relate to each other in order to provide excellent service to customers. Other departments are also explained to provide a full understanding of the organization of a hotel. Students are to practice their analyzing and problem solving skills with up-to-date real life example and current trends.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work
- Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.

3) Completion Criteria:
Every on-going assessment component > 0; Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >= 4

- Actively participate in class activities

learning_outcomes.details: Demonstrate highly professional attitude and discipline to the team, instructor and school regulation.
Explain the development of the lodging industry, the, definition of green hotels and the relation among department in the hotel divisions.
Describe the functions and operation of the various tasks, systems, forms, equipment and types of reservation used in the front office.
Illustrate the registration, selling, denying accommodation process and guestroom sales techniques that helps ensure a hotel's profitability.
Develop an efficient communication skill and security program in front office department to meet guest satisfaction and to resolve with guest complaints.
Understand and compute all transaction and the key formula for measuring hotel revenue that help to built hotel strategies for profit driven purposes
Demonstrate how rooms are asigned to housekeepers, housekeeping standards, check-out and settlement procedures
Explain the front office audit functions and process
Develop the management functions such as forecasting,evaluate the efficiency of front office operations and human resources management

metadata.description:
Main objective: The course aims for equipping students hands-on experiences as real front office employees through handle variety of tasks in each position under front office department.
Description: Taking school laboratory with standard of 3 star hotel as a real working environment, Front office management 2 focuses particularly on training practical skills in front office deparment for students. The course allows student to experience detailed daily tasks of each position cross front office department such as receptionist, phone operator, cashier, night auditor…etc…With various day to day situation to deal and to handle, learner will be familiar with front office operations enhancing competitive advantage on the hotel job market.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work
- Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.

Group Assignment Suggestion:
Students will be seperated into the team of 5 to10 people. The team is expected to operate the front office division as the standard of 5 star hotels. The teams will select the hotel brand by their own based on history, design concept, room categories, favorite service style. The groups will divide members themselves to ensure each menber cover a role in the front office division from Fom to cashier, bell, receptionist…. On the day of performance, the team will manage unexpected situations given by lecturers or other group students altogether. Before practical day, the teams must submit a presentation with the content of hotel name, information, characteristics,philosophy, design, service style and team members.
Grading is based on performance in class (70%), check point quality (10%), ppts presentation (20%).
The performance should be filmed for review.

assessments.grading_guide: - To create a disciplined environment and maintain a professional interface as a internationl hotelier standard, It is manatory for student to follow two indispensible aspects in service industry as a grading criteria, which are attitude and professional grooming.
assessments.note:
Students must comply perfectly with school & class regulation such as grooming, uniform, personal hygiene and attitude coming to demo front office with details the following:
1. Attitude
- Work seriously and attentively
- Respect and protect school asset.
- Strongly communication and teamworking.
- Be on time with professional grooming
2. Dress & Grooming Code
For Boys:
- School uniform or personal clothes including Black Trousers, White Shirt Full Sleeves, Tie or Vest
(Entering class with Jeans & T shirts is not allowed)
-The sleeves of a full sleeve shirt should never be rolled up.
- Formal shoes (black) and black socks.
- No Ear rings, bangles except for religious purpose are allowed in the class.
- Any kind of hair dye and spike hair style is strictly prohibited.
- In winter black coat and black pullover.
- Wearing of Name tag is mandatory for all students during class
For Girls:
- School Uniform or personal clothes such as Black Trousers, White Shirt Full Sleeves, Vest or Ao dai
(Entering class with Jeans & T shirts is not allowed)
- The sleeves of shirt should never be rolled up.
- Formal black shoes with ankle high socks.
- No visible painting including mehendi and tattoos.
- Only one ear ring/top.
- In winter black coat and black cardigan without collar are allowed.
- Hair should be tied in Bun shape during class.

metadata.title: Housekeeping management_Quản lý buồng phòng
metadata.description:
Main objective: This course aims to equip students with the skills to manage resources, administer assets and familiar with several key procedures of housekeeping cleanliness process.
-Description: Housekeeping management examines the role of supervisory function in housekeeping management such as inventory & equipment management, characteristics of materials, linen & laundry management, cleaning functions, the technical details of cleaning a room and control of supplies and equipment.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work
- Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.
-Completion Criteria:
Every on-going assessment component > 0; Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >= 4

Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance

learning_outcomes.details: To describe the role of the housekeeping department in hotel operations, and explain the importance of effective communication between housekeeping department and other departments
To understand the responsibility of executive housekeeping and how to manage efficiently deparmental human resource

metadata.description:
-Main objective: The aim of this subject is to integrate knowledge with front office, housekeeping and others relevant departments in accommodation and apply them to problem solving in the areas of room division management. The course provides learners the necessary knowledge and skills to become a room division manager.
-Description: During the course, students are practiced to design a room division department, apply the plan in real operation. Learners will be trained in management skills in several key aspects of room division management including operational administration, human resource management and departmental revenue optimization.
-Teaching method: Lecture, Desmontration, Role Play, Project based learning, Cooperative Learning
metadata.student_tasks:
Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Comply with the time and regulation
- Professional grooming
- Respect and protect school asset.
- Strongly communication and teamworking.

learning_outcomes.details: Design an overall standard of procedures plan of hotel or resort operation
Develop corporate social responsibility expected of professionals working in accommodation
Describe functions of different departments of a hotel and building the interrelationships among departments.
Apply management skills in designing the service process in room division
Design human resource management program
Build departmental budget
Evaluate service quality of room division
Communicate in a professional and courtesy Brand’s style
Develop leadership skills
Identify and resolve problems relevant to accommodation areas

metadata.title: Service Operation Management_Quản trị vận hành dịch vụ
metadata.description:
Main objective: This course provides students the understanding of the various approaches, design and strategies for achieving operational success in major service sectors such as health care, technical support services, banking and financial services, transportation; yet mainly focus on restaurants, hotels and resorts.
-Description: The course addresses strategic analysis and operational decision making in mananing a service bussiness. The course illustrate the steps of creating the service concept and operations strategy, the design of effective service delivery systems, quality management and improvement which ensure operational competitiveness in service businesses.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the key challenges facing service operations managers and the role of service operations management, its contribution to organisational success.
Demonstrate highly professtional attitude and discipline to the team, instructor and school regulation.
Develop and apply the service concept to define and communicate the nature of the business, create organisational alignment, drive innovation and strategic advantage, and design the service.
Develop ‘customer’ relationships and gain insight into customers’ expectations and perceptions to create satisfied customers.
Develop supplier relationships
Design the service process and the customer experience.
Organize, measure, control and manage service operations.
Arrange human resources effectively to deliver great service.
Develop a range of tools and learn from other operations to improve service performance
Create and implement an organisation’s service strategy and a world-class organisation and deliver

metadata.title: Wines, Beers, Spirits 1_Nghiệp vụ pha chế đồ uống 1
metadata.description:
-Objective: To provides the basic knowledge about the berverage industry as well as the knowledge of the world beverage culture in operating the Restaurant - Bar.
-Description: A study of the beverage service of the Hospitality Industry including spirits, wines, beers and mixology beverages. Topics include purchasing, resource control, beverage storage and issuing, bar stocks and sales control, bar customer care, safety and security, managing bar wastage, the law and sale of liquor.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work
- Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.

learning_outcomes.details: Develop general knowledge on the origins and development of the beverage industry.
Develop ability to work quietly; with cooperation; patience, carefulness, cleanliness and aesthetic values.
Indicate the effects of alcohol in the human body, both positive and negative, from health claims to the latest hangover research.
Develop an overall concept and tailor it to meet the needs and desires of a particular clientele.
Identify and distinguish types of glassware, mixing tools and equipment specifications and uses
Distinguish between fermented and distilled beverages and identify them on your shelves.
Classify wines according to type and recognize some of their distinguishing characteristics.
Prepare and pratice opening techniques of wine bottle and wine service techniques.
Outline the origins of beer and the market trends affecting today’s brewing industry.
Develop a sense of good discipline, a sense of responsibility, and a sense of serious work in the assigned work as well as with colleagues.

metadata.title: Food Preparation and Science_ Khoa học và chế biến thực phẩm
metadata.description:
Description: This course is designed to introduce students to properties of foods and changes that occur during preparation. Students will learn basic skills in food preparation and presentation while implementing food safety and sanitation standards. Topics to be covered include prevention of food-borne illness through proper handling of potentially hazardous foods, food safety management, GMP procedures, legal guidelines, kitchen safety, facility sanitation, and guidelines for safe food preparation, storing, and reheating... The program also includes a visit 3-4 restaurants or food production lines.
The course also introduces Vietnamese regulations on food and beverage safety.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

Demonstrate a diligent, serious attitude during class and a professional attitude during field sessions

systems for monitoring current activities (the present), and the techniques
required to anticipate what is to come (the future).

materials.description: Principles of Food Beverage and Labor Cost Controls
materials.author: Dittmer P.R & Keefe, J.D

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the income statement of an food and beverage business
Know how to analyze menu for profitability and create system to prevent internal and external threats to revenuue
Know how to develop a procedure to record current sales and develop a procedure to predict future sales.

Know how to use sales histories and standardized recipes to determine the amount of food products to purchase in a cost-effective manner, and implement proper procedures for receiving food and beverage products.
Understand how to implement an effective product storage and inventory system to control the issuing of products from storage and food and beverage production process
Understand how to accurately calculate food and beverage costs and their cost percentages for better controlling operation’s cost of sales and its cost of sales
Know how to choose the best menu format for a specific foodservice operation and Identify the variables to be considered when establishing menu prices.
Understand how to indentify the factors that affect employee productivity and to develop labor standards and employee schedules used in a foodservice operation.
Know how to classify and categorize other expenses in terms of being fixed, variable, or mixed to compute other expense costs in terms of cost per guest and as a percentage of sales
Know how to prepare income (profit and lost) statement to analyze sales and expese

metadata.description:
-Objective: To provides the basic knowledge about the berverage industry as well as the knowledge of the world beverage culture in operating the Restaurant - Bar.
-Description: This course is the continued part of RES213. This course focus on the beverage service of the Hospitality Industry including spirits, wines, beers and mixology beverages. Topics include purchasing, resource control, beverage storage and issuing, bar stocks and sales control, bar customer care, safety and security, managing bar wastage, the law and sale of liquor.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work
- Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.details: Manage and correctly arrange sanitation standards and routines for the bar setup.
Present basic knowledge about tea and coffee beverages
Outline the history of Mixology.
Explain the Stirring, Shaking, Blending, and Building methods of drink mixing.
Identify and outline the types of jobs in the beverage industry.
Identify the functions and relations of the purchase order, the invoice, and the credit memo.
Identify the needs of targeting a clientele.
Create and use a workable business plan for a bar.
Develop a sense of good discipline, a sense of responsibility, and a sense of serious work in the assigned work as well as with colleagues.
Develop ability to work quietly; with cooperation; patience, carefulness, cleanliness and aesthetic values.

metadata.description:
-Objective: Upon the rapid growth of the meeting, expositions, events and conventions industry (MEEC), the subject is aimed to provide an introduction to the MEEC industry and an opportunity for the learner to describe, analyse and evaluate the resources required to organise an MEEC, basing on that to develop a full plan and to implement an event.
-Description: It gives a comprehensive overview of the burgeoning field of planning and producing MEEC — meetings, expositions, events, and conventions with the study of varied segments of the field, along with discussions of new trends.
-Teaching method: lecturing in combination with case study analysis, MEEC practice
metadata.student_tasks:
- Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

materials.description: Meetings, Expositions, Events, and Conventions: An Introduction to the Industry
materials.author: Fenich G. G.

learning_outcomes.details: To describe the profession and the structure of the MEEC industry
To critically identify the role and functions of each key player in the MEEC industry, including organisers, sponsors, DMOs, venues, contractors, destination management companies
To examine the use of facilities for meetings and conventions
To clarify the structure of and the organisation issues in the exhibition sector
To analyse different planning elements in MEEC industry, including food & beverage, legal issue, technology, green issue, international issues
To develop and implement a full plan for an MEEC of different aspects
To build a professional manner as an MEEC planner

metadata.description:
This course helps students answer three important questions: what is event public relations, why do we do it, and how do we do it?
This course applies the knowledge and skills needed by a public relations practitioner to design, organize and publish a special event as part of a broader public relations program or as an independent communication tool. Students will learn how to execute a PR campaign for an event and how to effectively lead and motivate a team. Students also participate in practical training to organize an event.
- Instructors will use a number of teaching methods such as group discussions and experience sharing, practical work practice instead of conventional teaching.
- Students will have the opportunity to present their work and thought processes related to this work.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to participate the PR campaign pitch for event.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

assessments.note:
Option 1: Critical Essay
At home
Task Description:
The critical essay is intended to help students identify basic concepts and principles of effective public relations by analysing a key development, change or issue applied to the field of PR and professional communication.
Students will choose a topic, from the list provided, or they may provide a detailed topic of their own to be cleared in writing by the lecturer. The topics are intended to justify some of the themes covered in the course and provide them with the opportunity to gain their knowledge and examine how their topic impacts on society, publics, consumers and professional practice.
Notes:
Students should provide clear illustrations/examples in their essay to show their understanding of the topic.
All topics are written as a draft. Lecturers have the privilege to change the content of each topic as much as they want.
Choose one from the following essay topics:
Topic 1: What are the pros and cons of using a celebrity as part of a promotional event?
Topic 2: Describe the work of an entertainment publicist. Would you be interested in applying for the job of press coordinator?
Topic 3: Why is it important for event executives to have a good relationship with the mass media? How can you as a PR professional facilitate that relationship?

Option 2: (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal

metadata.title: Tourism and Travel Management_Quản trị du lịch và lữ hành
metadata.description:
The general objective of the course is to elucidate the intricate relationships existing between travel, transport and tourism and their functioning.

The course focuses on introduction of tourism in general; its links with travel, air transport; airline operation and management; airport functioning; the role played by land and water transportation in tourism; the way the travel industry products are distributed; the value being added during the process of tour operation; functioning and management of tour operation businesses; and the nuances of tour guide. The course also deals with the demand and supply factors, influencing factors, impacts of information technology in travel intermediation and impacts of mass travel and tourism.

Lecturing is the main teaching method in the theory part. However, the lecturer is required to provide relevant practical and hands-on experiences by using case studies or sharing personal experiences. The learners are encouraged to actively participate in lectures by active and student-centered teaching methods such as reciprocal questioning, games, rotating chair group discussions, rountable meeting or by self-learning and preparations before the lecture, Practical training sessions are organized to allow the learners to develop their initial skills and behaviors on the tourism and travel occupational/ opereational standards. Furthermore the group assignment project will strengthen leaners' technical and soft skills such as research, team work, leadership, problem solving, work planning and scheduling, presentation and so on.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Class attendance is mandatory. Attending at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Be actively participate in class activities such as Q & A, group works, practical exercises, field works, presentation, etc.
- Fulfill tasks given by the instructor, including the group assignment project and practical training sessions
- Use their own laptop and smartphone in class only for learning purposes and when requested
- Read the textbooks, other reading documents and do homework in advance
- Access the course page on the selected education management platforms like Zoom, MS Teams, Google Class or Moodle for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for assessment.

learning_outcomes.details: Identify and narrate the concept of tourism, the evolution and the nuances of the tourism industry
Identify and describe the role, types and elements of multimodal transport in the context of tourism
Identify and explain the role, types, functions and organization of travel intermediaries in tourism
Identify and explain the role, types, functions and organization of tour operators in tourism
Apply skills and techniques in performing fundamental tasks of operational staffs in transport and travel businesses
Construct, develop ethics, professionalism and spirit of self-study and life-long learning in the transport and travel careers
Practice and apply work skills including foreign language, communication, analytics, critical thinking, creativity and innovation, team work and problem solving

assessments.note:
OP1: Class is divided into 4-5 groups.
The plan of the fieldtrip will be built by class and submitted to teacher for approval before travelling.
The video is made as a result of the fieldtrip.
Each group will be required to do a task in the trip and recording the task they implement. The details requirements are as follow:
1. The video record should show the title: "Field trip for Tourism Geography subject".
2. The video should have university's logo and students should wear school's uniform (if possible).
3. The video should declare the names of group's members.
4. Each group can record the backstage sceneries for enriching the content of the video.
5. Topics will be chosen randomly and assign for students by teachers. Topics suggested are:
- Introduce overview (general) information about the chosen site (i.e. history of establishment, natural/cultural tourism resources, features of the destination's attraction, suitable tourism products).
- Introduce clearly about tourism infrastructure and superstructure of the site (i.e: accommodation, food and beverage, entertainment and recreational activities, etc.).
- Introduce about tourism route to travel to the site, means of transportation used to visit the site and the stopover(s) during the route of travelling.
- Travel tips and note for tourists when visiting the site (time, season, climate, what to bring, how to deal with locals, what to try in the site)
- Identify problems/issues of the site and give recommendation to improve the situation (from your own thought of the site).
An additional written report is submitted together with the video that clearly explain what you've done in the video as requested in each group (it will work as the subtitle for the video).
On the day of the presentation, each group will spend time answering questions from lecturers and other groups about his field trip

metadata.title: Vietnamese Culture _ Cơ sở văn hóa Việt Nam
metadata.description:
This course is designed to provide students with a understanding of the foundations and the dimensions of Vietnamese culture, origin, characteristic; pay particular attention to the relationship between Vietnamese culture and the present-day life of the Vietnamese people and to the different elements of the culture which are under the social structures, belief systems, literature, arts, customs, etc... Topics mainly include: (1) the foundations of Vietnamese civilization: its geography, language, and history; (2) the core concepts in Vietnamese thoughts and religions: Aninism, Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, Catholicism, the new sects religion;...(3) Literature (4) Society and Life, including education, the role of women, Vietnamese food, festivals and leisure activities ; (5) Arts and Architecture (6) Vietnamese performing arts like Ca trù, Tuồng, Hát Bội...
-Teaching method: Presentation, Discussion, teamwork, critical thinking, field-trip.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the foundations and dimensions of Vietnamese culture. Interpret and absorb the essence of Vietnamese culture.
Explain Vietnam's history and the change of Vietnamese culture over the different historical periods.
Analyze cultural phenomena.
Evaluate the problem from the cultural perspective, aesthetic creation and thriving for success in the globalization context.
Developing essential skills in building or constructing a typical product reflecting cultural aspects.
Having a professional attitude, critical thinking and teamwork.

assessments.note:
Each team needs to create a Timeline of Vietnamese Cultural History (following the timeline from the founding of the country to the present) –
Presentation: In-class presentation of 25–30 minutes, followed by 5–10 minutes Q&A.

metadata.title: Destination Management and Marketing_Quản trị điểm đến và Marketing
metadata.description:
-Course objectives: The subject is aimed at providing a vital and comprehensive understanding of destination marketing and management
-Description: Managing destinations is an area of growing importance as tourism regions compete to provide unique experiences and exceptional value to visitors. Principles and concepts of building strong destinations are explored to assist future tourism professionals in establishing stronger regional & international tourism organizations while responding to the needs and wants of community residents.
-Teaching method: Basic input will be given by the lecturer in order to initiate discussions on the relevant topics. Therefore, students are required to prepare the reading material in advance. In class, short group works will take place. This should further stimulate discussion between students and allow them to immediately apply theoretical knowledge to mini-case studies. Additionally, discussion should allow students to reflect on observations of tourist destinations and identify linkages with management and marketing activities.

- Use laptop in class only for learning purposes
- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.details: To examine and differentiate the key concepts and roles of marketing and management of destinations
To identify the stakeholders in destination management, the types of destination management organisations and the relationships they are in
To assess the nature and process of planning and research for destination management and marketing
To appreciate the key concerns in developing destination product
To highlight and develop the leadership, partnership and governance in destination management
To clarify the need for and the procedure of visitor management
To discuss the concept and the steps to build destination positioning, image, branding and intergrated marketing communications
To be able to build a comprehensive plan for marketing and management of a destination
To appreciate and develop a professional and critical attitude towards the job of destination marketing and management

-Objective: The subject is aimed at providing a vital understanding of contemporary tourist behaviour and its application in a variety of sectors of tourism.
-Description: Students will acquire broad knowledge of consumer behavior in tourism and hospitality industry. They will be able to describe and explain tourist behaviors through the perspectives of human psychology.They can also determine the role of tourist behaviors in the process of tourism product development, quality management and other marketing decisions.
-Teaching Method:
Basic input will be given by the lecturer in order to initiate discussions on the relevant topics. Therefore, students are required to prepare the reading material in advance. In class, short group works will take place. This should further stimulate discussion between students and allow them to immediately apply theoretical knowledge to mini-case studies. Additionally, discussion should allow students to reflect on observations of own or (other) tourists’ behaviour and identify linkages with management and marketing of tourism (products).

materials.description: The Routledge Handbook of Consumer Behaviour in Hospitality and Tourism
materials.author: Saurabh Kumar Dixit

learning_outcomes.details: To explain the concept and models of consumer behavior in tourism and hospitality industry
To get insight into the how today’s consumers select, purchase, use and experience the tourism and hospitality products.
To identify different market segments and analyse the consumer behavior in different market and across the sectors in tourism and hospitality industry
To update with the development trend and controversial issues of tourism behaviour internationally and in Vietnam
To practice the professional attitude and skills of achieving understanding of consumer behavior before any decision in business decisions
To apply the understanding of the consumer behavior into product development, quality management and other marketing decisions in tourism

assessments.no_question: Presentation
assessments.knowledge_and_skill: Case study analysis and questions given with the case
assessments.grading_guide: All chapters
assessments.note: Students will work in group of 4-5 students and will be scheduled to be in charge of one case study given in the coursebook (allocated by instructors) which is related to the topics learnt in the earlier weeks. They have to analyse the case study by answering the questions given with the case.

Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.

assessments.knowledge_and_skill: Tourism market to Vietnam: profile development and analysis
assessments.grading_guide: All chapters
assessments.note: Students will work in group of 4-5 students and will be given a tourism market to be in charge of. They are required to develop a detailed profile of the market and to analyse the consumer behavior of the market. Basing on the profile and analysis, suggestions for product development, marketing activities and quality management should be made.
